column2: [intro]
I woke up this morning with a thought in mind,
A sad song that makes me rewind,
Loving Philippe Katerine, but not listening all the time,
His songs constantly, it's too much to unwind.
Loving Katerine can sometimes be a strain,
His crazy melodies drive me insane,
But sometimes I need a break, it’s essential,
To avoid tiring of his style, it’s crucial.
His quirky humor makes me laugh out loud,
But an overdose of Katerine can be quite a crowd.
I need musical variety, that’s a fact,
To enjoy his songs without losing track.
Loving Katerine can sometimes be a strain,
His crazy melodies drive me insane,
But sometimes I need a break, it’s essential,
To avoid tiring of his style, it’s crucial.
[solo]
Loving Katerine, but without the overdose,
That’s the secret to keep the flame that glows.
Each song is a gem, a prose,
And I'll take care not to fall into an overdose.
[outro]
